problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:

* Shipment Alpha: volume 54 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: volume 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: volume 34 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: volume 69 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: volume 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: volume 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: volume 39 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: volume 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: volume 64 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: volume 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: volume 36 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: volume 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: volume 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: volume 52 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: volume 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: volume 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: volume 52 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: volume 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: volume 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: volume 30 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: volume 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: volume 59 cubic meters
* Shipment Psi: volume 53 cubic meters
* Shipment Omega: volume 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Ares: volume 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Boreas: volume 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Ceres: volume 30 cubic meters
* Shipment Demeter: volume 54 cubic meters
* Shipment Eos: volume 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Faunus: volume 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Gaia: volume 67 cubic meters
* Shipment Helios: volume 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Iris: volume 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Janus: volume 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Kronos: volume 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Luna: volume 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Morpheus: volume 37 cubic meters

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 cubic meters of freight. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes possible. Every shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume on any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
